definitions.BASE: Extract the literal base value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.BINDING: Extract the literal binding value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.BRAND: Brand explicitly identifying the offered product, not a compatibility target.
definitions.BUS_SPEED: Explicit system bus speed, not processor clock speed.
definitions.CACHE: Extract the literal cache value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.CAPACITY: Explicit storage or holding capacity; distinguish capacity from package count.
definitions.CLOCK_SPEED: Explicit processor clock frequency, preserving source spelling and units.
definitions.CLOSURE: Extract the literal closure value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.COLOR: A color value for the COLOR attribute; keep separate from COLOR_S.
definitions.COLOR_S: The Color(s) attribute in this ontology; do not rename it COLOR.
definitions.COOLING: Extract the literal cooling value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.DEPTH: Front-to-back dimension; do not infer it solely from an unlabeled dimension sequence.
definitions.FLAVOR: Extract the literal flavor value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.GAUGE: Extract the literal gauge value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.GENDER: Extract the literal gender value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.GENERATION: Extract the literal generation value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.HEAT: Extract the literal heat value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.HEIGHT: Vertical dimension; require explicit context identifying height. Do not guess axis order.
definitions.LENGTH: Length dimension; require support for this axis rather than guessing width or height.
definitions.MANUFACTURER: Explicit maker of the product; do not automatically equate with brand.
definitions.MANUFACTURER_STOCK_NUMBER: Exact manufacturer stock identifier; preserve punctuation.
definitions.MATERIAL: Explicit material of the offered product, not an inferred constituent.
definitions.METAL_TYPE: Extract the literal metal type value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.MODEL_NUMBER: Extract the literal model number value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.MOUNTING: Extract the literal mounting value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.PACKING_TYPE: Extract the literal packing type value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.PACK_QUANTITY: Number of items in the offered pack, box or carton, not storage capacity.
definitions.PAGE_YIELD: Explicit printing yield, not model numbers or pack size.
definitions.PAPER_WEIGHT: Explicit paper weight; do not reinterpret basis weight as product mass.
definitions.PART_NUMBER: Exact part identifier; preserve punctuation and capitalization.
definitions.PORTS: Extract the literal ports value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.PROCESSOR_CORE: Extract the literal processor core value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.PROCESSOR_QUANTITY: Extract the literal processor quantity value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.PROCESSOR_TYPE: Extract the literal processor type value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.PRODUCT_TYPE: Literal product type phrase from the text, not a paraphrased category.
definitions.RETAIL_UPC: Exact UPC identifier; preserve leading zeros.
definitions.ROTATIONAL_SPEED: Explicit rotational speed, preserving its source spelling and units.
definitions.SHAPE: Extract the literal shape value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.SHEET_PERFORATION: Extract the literal sheet perforation value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.SHELVES: Extract the literal shelves value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.SIZE_WEIGHT: Explicit size/weight value under the Size/Weight field; preserve original units.
definitions.SPLASH: Extract the literal splash value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.STAINLESS_STEEL_SERIES: Extract the literal stainless steel series value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.STONES_SETTING: Extract the literal stones setting value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.STONES_TOTAL_WEIGHT: Extract the literal stones total weight value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.STONES_TYPE: Extract the literal stones type value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.STONE_SHAPE: Extract the literal stone shape value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.THERMAL_DESIGN_POWER: Extract the literal thermal design power value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.VOLTAGE: Extract the literal voltage value; omit it if not explicitly supported.
definitions.WIDTH: Width dimension; distinguish it from height, depth and length using explicit context.
